punchline: Students who resisted cookies gave up sooner, but 23 labs could not repeat the effect.
thirty_sec: In 1998 Baumeister had hungry students eat radishes instead of cookies; they quit an unsolvable puzzle sooner. In 2016, 23 labs with 2,141 participants measured d = 0.04. A vivid study is a question to test again.
question: Which striking claim have you repeated that nobody has tested outside where it first appeared?
key_contrast: Real result in one room, doubtful law of the mind.
